findings.claim: ICDAR 2023 IHTR (IIIT-H): 10 scripts incl Bengali; Upstage KR won with 95.94% avg char accuracy; 18 teams registered, 6 submitted. Ledger frames this as clean-script SOTA far from citizen-doc reality.
ICDAR 2025 IHDR (IIIT-H): page-level Indic handwritten document recognition; winner announced 2025-05-15 but ledger records no winner or score (watch item left open).
Sarvam Vision 2.1 (2026-09-24/25) claims improved Indic handwriting recognition, form KV and multi-page tables; ledger treats tables+forms+handwriting as the 3 Bhashini demo axes.
Bodhan IndicOCR supports handwriting for EN + 12 Indian langs (printed: EN + 22 langs x 13 scripts); internal IndicOCR-Printed bench 86.2% word accuracy; trained on 15M+ docs; API Rs0.20/image.
Chitrapathak-2 HF card notes degradation on handwriting/noise/forms/index layouts (so not a handwriting engine).
BHASHA 2025: 14 SOTA models evaluated on Indic script OCR; substantial CER reduction via fine-tuning on an ancient-handwriting dataset (no numbers given).
Bharat Scene Text: 27k words across 11+ Indic langs; DBnet detector + PARSeq recognizer trained on synthetic Indic data (PARSeq on 11 langs). Precedent for synthetic-trained PARSeq word recognizers.
IIIT-H NLTM IndicSTR12-Hindi scene-text word set: 1,083 word images, 585 unique words, split 812/271 (word-level dataset precedent; Hindi, not Bengali).

Ledger has NO Bengali handwritten-word-specific recognizer, WRR benchmark or IIIT-INDIC-HW-WORDS entry; handwriting coverage limited to ICDAR23 IHTR and ICDAR25 IHDR pointers plus Bodhan/Sarvam claims.
Harness-with-VLM is the dominant 2025-26 pattern (Sarvam Vision 2.1, Bodhan, PaddleOCR-VL-1.6, MonkeyOCR); a single VLM is no longer competitive.

Sarvam Vision 2.1: 3B state-space VLM, 23 langs (22 Indic + EN), harness = semantic layout parser + pointer reading-order; CPT on sovereign 3B -> SFT -> RL with verifiable rewards; per-language synth/human ratio and curriculum NOT disclosed. API only, not routable.

Bodhan IndicOCR: 33M layout (PP-DocLayoutV3/RT-DETR) + 0.8B block OCR (Qwen3.5-0.8B), ~1.8GB weights, Apache/Indic Open Model License, layout JSON + markdown/block JSON; lineage Qwen3.5 + Sarvam tokenizer; NeMo-trained, TensorRT-LLM/vLLM served.
Bodhan explicitly targeted skipped scripts incl Kashmiri, Santali, Manipuri (Meetei Mayek); 0.8B holds its own vs 4-5x larger models; live 2026-09-05. Rival aims at our weakest cells.

PaddleOCR-VL-1.6: 0.9B (NaViT + ERNIE-4.5-0.3B), 96.33 OmniDocBench v1.6, Apache-2.0, vLLM path, drop-in from 1.5; CPT 16.8M + SFT 7.3M + RL; Real5-OmniDocBench 93.19 (warp 91.25 weakest, scan 94.74 best); ~2GB VRAM FP16, ~45 pg/min L40S.

Surya 2: 650M, 83.3 olmOCR-bench (best <3B), 91-lang internal 87.2 (38 langs >=90), 5.35 pg/s RTX 5090; code Apache-2.0 but weights modified OpenRAIL-M (revenue cap <$5M) -> licence check before shipping; no language-hint param; 178 s on a Hindi page on 8GB laptop.

Chitrapathak-2 (Krutrim): fine-tune Nanonets-OCR2-3B (Qwen2.5-VL) beats LLaVA-from-scratch Chitrapathak-1 on accuracy and 3-6x latency; Telugu char ANLS 6.69 vs 11.00; Parichay 9 govt-doc types 89.8% EM ~1.03 s/doc with rotation-normalisation pre-pass; Tesseract+LLM only 21.22% EM. Covers 10 langs+EN incl Bengali, Odia.

dots.ocr: 1.7B-3B Qwen2.5-VL-based unified parser, 100+ langs incl Kannada/Tibetan, Apache-2.0 (also reported MIT); OmniDocBench composite 88.41 vs Paddle 92.86 in codesota; ledger recommends zero-shot comparison.
MinerU2.5-Pro 1.2B (NaViT-675M + Qwen2-0.5B): 95.69 OmniDocBench v1.6 vs 92.98 for MinerU2.5 via data engineering only (+2.71) -> keep backbone, spend on data.

Chandra (Datalab, Qwen3-VL 9B): 83.1 +/- 0.9 olmOCR-Bench, highest open as of Oct 2025; LightOnOCR-2-1B 76.4 olmOCR-Bench (OldScan 84.7 English); olmOCR-2 Devanagari chrF++ 40.5; olmOCR-2 is English-centric and cannot be the Indic engine.

Devanagari stress-test (Maheshwari et al.): synthetic chrF++ 91-98 hides differences; on real Hindi scans 9/10 systems collapse; Qwen3-VL-8B 75.2 beats GPT-5.5 58.5 and olmOCR-7B 40.5; report median + catastrophic rate not mean; byte-level post-corrector works only on matched noise, fails cross-engine.
FaithC4 (Amazon): general VLMs rewrite imperfect text (WER +6.9); OCR-specialised VLMs stay faithful (+0.1-3.4) -> use OCR-specialised VLMs for citizen docs.

IIIT-H deployable OCR (ICDAR 2023): CRNN+CTC page OCR for 13 languages beats Tesseract5 and Google Cloud Vision on 8/13 langs; Bhashini catalog has IIITH-OCR-SceneText for 8 langs (as/bn/gu/hi/kn/ml/mni/mr) as production line.

Training recipe consensus (MANIFEST): SFT->RLVR universal; fine-tune OCR-specialised VLM > from-scratch; open pool SOTA-competitive since Oct 2025; data engineering > architecture; synthetic+real mixture; restoration pre-pass for OldScan; specialists for low-resource scripts.

Candidate bases listed for W6 freeze: PaddleOCR-VL-1.6 (Apache, 0.9B), Qwen2.5-VL family (foundation of dots.ocr/Chitrapathak-2/Chandra/Nanonets), Bodhan IndicOCR; script-router justified by IndicTrans2 5-script design and Poddar optical script ID (12 Indic scripts).

OmniDocBench v1.6 (2026-04-10) / v1.7 (2026-04-30): 1,355 pages, 9 doc types; PaddleOCR-VL-1.6 96.33-96.34; ledger itself notes Paddle 96.33 vs 96.34 and 92.86 in different sources (minor inconsistency).

Sarvam Vision 2.1 per-language Indic OCR Bench word accuracy: Santali 53.91, Kashmiri 54.82, Manipuri 85.12, Odia 80.01; OldScan 55.3; high cells Maithili 96.70, Konkani 97.41, Nepali 97.00, Marathi 95.06.

Bodhan beats Sarvam on Santali 68.30 vs 53.91; Gemini beats Sarvam on Odia 81.01 vs 80.01; AWS Textract ~0 on most Indic langs. Odia fine-tune must beat Chitrapathak-2 + Gemini 81.01, not just Sarvam.

Sarkar et al. (IIIT-H, ICDAR 2024) Mozhi-LR(S): CRNN+LM char/word acc Kashmiri 87.71/93.80, Ol Chiki Santali 90.60/96.58, Bodo 93.84/97.22, Nepali 82.60/95.13; Sanskrit/Maithili/Konkani share a Hindi model; Hindi model fails on Sindhi/Kashmiri extended chars -> specialist required for Ol Chiki and Kashmiri Perso-Arabic.

R2 Nastaliq (via A0-004): QARI CER 0.550->0.061 with 50k pure-synthetic SFT of Qwen2-VL-2B; UTRSet synth-only 75.14% vs real-trained 90.87% (15-pt residual). Mixing rule 40-60k synthetic + 300-500 hand-corrected REAL lines.

R3 Ol Chiki/Mayek (via A0-005): synthetic-only SFT reaches classical-OCR parity (Nayana CER 0.227 vs Tesseract 0.206); rescues zero-corpus scripts (Maltese LV-ROVER); correction-stage synthetic beats real (Bourne -55% CER). Synthetic alone caps CER; real data needed for last 5-15 pts.

Ol Chiki is a true alphabet (not abugida; glottalization, checked plosives); ledger inference: shared training with abugidas structurally doomed -> specialist-only. Santali also written in Bengali, Odia, Devanagari scripts (sat_14 Bengali-script Santali).

ScriptMoE: shared encoder + top-2 script experts + shared expert; PP-OCRv5 end-to-end F1 65.71->80.89 (scene text); Ol Chiki and Meitei Mayek are NOT among its 10 scripts so cannot be used directly for sat/mni.
Indic-OCR project provides Tesseract models incl Ol Chiki and Meetei Mayek; ledger says include as honest baseline for sat/mni but expect non-competitive.
Meitei Mayek is under-resourced in all modalities (TTS dataset single-speaker, ARPAbet); Warang Citi, Brahmi transliteration noted as watch items for script router.

OldScan: olmOCR-Bench Surya-2 OldScan sub-score 42.8; Sarvam 2.1 own OldScan 55.3 on Indic bench; ledger claims no Indic engine crosses 60 on OldScan. R4 mandate: ablation chain A0 none / A1 deskew+Otsu / A2 Sauvola-frozen / A3 DocRes-head pilot n<=8; adopt bar median dCER <= -0.03, 95% bootstrap CI, >=2/3 frozen engines; DIBCO is Latin/Greek only.

Restoration SOTA catalogue (all English/Chinese-measured, none Indic): DocRes CVPR24 (5 tasks), Uni-DocDiff, DocDiff (4.17M HRR), TextSR, DocRevive (30,078 synthetic degraded images), UniT, DvD, D2Dewarp, SauvolaNet+DE-GAN lead DIBCO17; Hybrid dewarp median CER 0.0235 IWILT; warp is weakest distortion (Real5 91.25).
PreP-OCR (arXiv 2505.20429) reframes pipeline as restoration + semantic post-OCR correction; ledger proposes Stage 0 + Stage 3b fusion.

Post-correction: Scrambled-text (Bourne, IJDAR 2025) synthetic-corruption trained LM cuts Hindi OCR median CER 55% and WER 32% vs base LM and beats real-data training; corruption distribution matters. BHASHA 2025 GCN verifier (ResNet-50 + 3-conv GCN) helps conjunct-heavy Hindi.
PaddleOCR-VL-1.6 ablation: CPT +0.69, SFT +0.63 more, RL only +0.08 (94.93->96.33). RLVR only after SFT plateau.
olmOCR-2: 1 epoch SFT then 1 epoch GRPO with binary unit-test rewards (HTML element presence + read-order tests); verifiable unit tests > learned reward model.

R7 W6 training tree binding decisions: SFT allow-list = human pairs + synthetic only; PDF-layer GT per-language only after sec 6.4 + 6.2 pass; sarvam_fill NEVER trains; RLVR on human-verified gold ONLY after sec 6.6 no-inversion.

Probe scorer law (A0-008): n=1227 over 18 langs 100/lang; per-row uncapped CER + cer_100_count, single denominator, empty pred = CER 1.0; raw-vs-normalized ablation 0.6707 vs 0.6692 (delta 0.0015) gates RLVR scorer.
SimPO (reference-free, half the memory of DPO) proposed as cheaper DPO replacement for Stage 3b preference tuning.

Inference cost refs: Mistral OCR 3 $2/1000 pages ($1 batch); Sarvam doc API Rs0.5/page (Jun-2026 67% price cut); Bodhan Rs0.20/image; Krutrim Chitrapathak Rs83.6/1M in, Rs34.53/1M out; DeepSeek-OCR 64-400 vision tokens, 11.3x compression, 89.8% OmniDocBench.

Constraints recorded in ledger harness_fact: 'WRAP only - no GPU W6 fine-tune of closed weights; open weights + local QLoRA only'; 'no training until W6 freeze'; offline-capable; no paid keys; 200-dpi citizen docs.

Sarvam Indic OCR Bench (sarvamai/indic-ocr-bench): 6,909 blocks (6,609 Indic + 300 EN), 22 langs + EN, word accuracy = 100x(1-WER); fetch requires user approval per sec 9 hard rule. v1 blog quoted 20,267 samples.
MANIFEST open item: data label audit - machine-GT trust scores (ne BARRED 26.6; ks/mr/gu/ur VERIFY-FIRST per R5).
Sarvam admits (TOI) bench != real-world utility: earlier version struggled with complex docs + hallucinations; trained on real+synthetic mix; ranked 2nd to PaddleOCR on structure-preservation.
Evaluation discipline: report median + catastrophic-repetition rate; synthetic chrF++ hides differences; word-acc vs CER caveats; pin Surya version/backend (v0.20 breaking API).

Competitive matrix on Indic OCR Bench: Sarvam 2.1 87.39 / Bodhan 84.94 / Gemini 3.6 Flash 79.35 / GCV 71.76; Sarvam Vision v1: Hindi 95.91, Bengali 92.61, Tamil 93.42, Telugu 87.70 beating Gemini 3 Pro, GCV, Opus 4.5.
Cost: Sarvam Rs0.5/page, 5,344 test pages ~ Rs2,672 (~$32); Bodhan Rs0.20 x 1,227 probe ~ Rs245; 54-call cap = free-trial only; full-bench API compare needs budget sign-off.

Sarvam funding $75M Series B 2026-08-04 at $1.43B valuation, total $350M; strongest funded Indic OCR rival. Bhashini LEAP hackathon PS-2 winners Multilipi, runner-up Soochna Sahayak; monitor Bimla series for AksharDrishti Stage-1 announcements.
Govt-doc demo pattern: rotation pre-pass + schema prompt + task fine-tune (Chitrapathak-2 Parichay); jury judging 'technical feasibility' - use VRAM/throughput rows (Paddle ~2GB, 45 pg/min).
Stage 3 LLM options (noisy OCR -> JSON): Krutrim-2 12B (MMLU 0.63, HellaSwag 0.83), Gemma4 31B beats Sarvam 30B on L3Cube-IndicQuest v2 (19 langs, 69,420 QA), IndicBERTv2 270M/1B/4B.

Normalisation tools: Aksharamukha (GPL 3.0, 120+ scripts) and IndicNLP normalizer (MIT: nukta decomposition, ZWJ/ZWNJ removal) proposed for GT/cross-script normalisation; error tags matra_order, conjunct, repetition, hallucination.
W1 locked challenger recipe: harness-with-VLM + fine-tune OCR-specialised VLM + SFT->RLVR + progressive curriculum (word->line->block->page) + specialist router for Santali/Kashmiri/Meitei/Nastaliq.

MANIFEST open questions for W6 freeze: base model, recipe (CPT->SFT->RLVR vs fine-tune), specialists via synthetic-first + real anchor, restoration A0-A3, Stage 3 LLM, post-correction, evaluation, inference cost, Indic OCR Bench fetch approval, GT label audit.
Ledger headline: 984 records (979 with all 10 sec 9 fields); MANIFEST upgrade date 2026-09-29; ledger date 2026-09-27; Sarvam is the benchmark target not a routable pipeline component.
